articles.title: Dolores Vasquez, 65, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Dolores Vasquez for the many years of service to Marsh Landing.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Marsh Landing. Born in Marsh Landing in the years after the war, Dolores Vasquez spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program in his or her name. Dolores Vasquez died in October at home on Heron Street, at the age of 65.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Marsh Landing.

articles.title: Letters: Laurel Drive Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the October meeting.
To the editor: I have lived on Laurel Drive for 32 years, and I want to say what a difference the Marsh Landing Pond Committee has made.
Please keep the basketball court in the budget. Many of us on Laurel Drive use it every week.
Carl Salazar, Foundry Row
